name: Dumbbell Full Can Scaption
steps: Stand upright holding very light dumbbells (1 to 5 lbs) at your sides with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Rotate your forearms so your thumbs are pointing upward and slightly outward, as if holding a full can of soda upright.
Keeping your elbows straight, raise your arms upward at a 30 to 45 degree angle in front of your body (the scapular plane).
Lift the dumbbells smoothly until your arms reach shoulder height (90 degrees of elevation).
Hold for 1 second at the top, maintaining the thumbs-up orientation.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to your sides over 2 seconds.
coaching_cues: Always keep thumbs pointing toward the ceiling to open the subacromial space and prevent impingement.
Do not lift above shoulder height (keep arms below 90 degrees).
Use light resistance; strict form and muscle isolation take priority over weight.

sources.attribution: AAOS Rotator Cuff and Shoulder Conditioning Program
